notes:
Lyriix Android v0.2.9

- Choose the part of your wallpaper to show with a drag-and-zoom preview. Apply saves your position; Cancel keeps the existing wallpaper. Use Adjust wallpaper to reposition it later, or Reset to center it.
- Fixed wallpaper and theme updates restarting the whole screen. Image loading, saving, and color detection use a dedicated background worker, with progress shown while processing. Playback and navigation stay connected.
- Detect theme colors now favors dominant color families in your selected crop instead of small bright highlights. Detection uses a small local sample and retains readable theme contrast.
- Wallpaper decoding no longer holds the shared image-cache lock, and applying a new wallpaper reuses its already-decoded image.
- Existing songs, queues, account data, pairing, and Android update signing remain compatible.
